name: Multi-Scale + Spectral-Gated CNN (MSSGNet)
tagline: Stack of 3 multi-scale depthwise-separable conv blocks (kernels 3/5/7, dilations 1,2,4) with progressive avg-pool, an FFT-amplitude SE-style channel gate, and triple (mean+max+attention) pooling.
formula:
$$\text{MultiScaleBlock: } x \leftarrow \mathrm{BN}(x + W_1\,\mathrm{Concat}_{k\in\{3,5,7\}}\mathrm{GELU}(\mathrm{DWConv}_{k,d}(x)))$$
$$\text{Spectral gate: } g = \sigma\!\bigl(W[\mathrm{mean}_f|\mathcal{F}x|,\,\mathrm{std}_f|\mathcal{F}x|]\bigr),\ x \leftarrow x \odot g$$
$$\text{dropout} = \mathrm{clip}(0.15 + 0.25\cdot\min(C/50, 1),\ 0.1,\ 0.45)$$
diff_from_baseline: Custom CNN distinct from dlinear/timesnet/patchtst baselines: multi-scale depthwise-separable convs at three kernel sizes with exponential dilation, progressive temporal downsampling, FFT-amplitude (mean+std) channel gating, and triple pooling head; dropout auto-scaled by enc_in.

name: FreqAttn + Dilated Conv + MHA + SE
tagline: Frequency-domain learnable amplitude weighting (FFT->scale->iFFT), stacked dilated multi-branch convs, multi-head temporal self-attention with padding mask, plus SE-style channel attention.
diff_from_baseline: Hybrid different from any baseline: per-bin learnable rFFT amplitude reweighting with iFFT residual, multi-branch dilated convs (rates 1/2/4/8), SE channel attention, and a final masked MHA temporal block; classifier reads the time-averaged token.

name: TV-Mixer (Time x Variable x Feature)
tagline: Patches the input (len 16, stride 8) into [B, V, P, d], then stacks temporal-mixer + variable-mixer + feature-mixer MLP blocks; Flatten and Linear classifier.

key_hyperparams.name: var hidden
key_hyperparams.role: variable-mixer hidden dim safe for V=1

diff_from_baseline: MLP-Mixer-style architecture distinct from baselines: factorized mixing across the patched-time axis, the variable axis, and the feature axis (all via simple two-layer MLPs with GELU); uses the library's PatchEmbedding from PatchTST but no attention.

name: Mask-Aware ChannelTimeMixer + Spectro-Temporal Head
tagline: Two ChannelTimeMixer blocks (channel MLP + 5/9-kernel depthwise conv on x and on diff(x), gated by raw vs diff summary), followed by a time-stat + log-power-spectrum disagreement-gated head.
diff_from_baseline: Custom architecture distinct from baselines: two stacked mask-aware mixer blocks with parallel raw and first-difference depthwise conv branches gated by a (mean, mean-of-abs-diff) summary, plus a classifier head that fuses time-domain stats and log-power FFT features through a disagreement-gated mix.
